Module type_manager

The module defines the names of base and compound types for railyard components. The corresponding types, GeoType for base types and CompoundGeoType for compound types, are constructed by the type manager TypeManager.

Classes
  TypeManager
A type manager constructs the base types and compound types for the railyard components of a railyard.
